Date: Sat, 1 Nov 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps + pick 2 slots for 30m technical deep dive

Hi Avery & Jose,

Thanks again for your time today — solid discovery call. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: real-time summarization and compliance metadata for customer support transcripts.
- Key constraint: sub-200ms token latency for hot-path, and data residency for EU in later phases.
- Success metric: reduce average handle time by 20% while preserving accuracy on intent extraction.

Next step: a 30-minute technical deep dive focused on integration architecture, latency targets, and sample payloads. Can you pick 2 slots that work for your team? Below are our suggested windows (all PST):

1) Tue Nov 4 — 10:00–10:30
2) Wed Nov 5 — 14:30–15:00
3) Thu Nov 6 — 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, send two preferred times and we’ll prioritize. Dev (cc) will cover runtime/SDK questions; Jonas will address deployment/entitlements.

Attached is a short 1-page agenda so we can stay focused.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference
